title: Treaty of Bakhchisarai
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Bakhchisarai", at revision 1379337401, opens: "The Treaty of Bakhchysarai or Treaty of Radzin, was signed by Muscovy, the Ottoman Empire, and the Crimean Khanate on 3 (13) January 1681 in Bakhchysarai. It established a 20-year truce, which ended the Russo-Turkish War (1676–1681)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q128388, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "peace treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
